answer: Require each agent to lock a slashable bond before transacting, with new identities starting at low trust and low limits. The bond is released only after verified, useful work, and misbehavior forfeits it. A sybil attacker must fund every fake identity and wait through the same slow probation for each one, instead of spinning up thousands of accounts for free. This is not a velvet rope that admits anyone once: like an orchard, trust grows only with sustained care, and a nebula of throwaway accounts cannot harvest reputation without paying the same capital and time cost as a real participant.
